cases.element: task.errors[1].feedbackUk: "Форма на -g- (hago) буває лише в теперішньому часі. В імперфекті: hacía."
cases.defect: The unqualified restriction of the g-form to the present tense is misleading: the hag- stem also occurs in formal imperatives such as haga and hagan. The relevant rule is that this stem does not carry into the imperfect.
cases.correction: Explain specifically that the present stem hag- is not used in the imperfect: hacer → hacía.
sources: RAE/ASALE, Diccionario de la lengua española, hacer conjugation table: present subjunctive and imperative forms haga, hagan (from memory).
cases.notes: The answer key itself is correct.

cases.element: task.options[0].feedbackUk: "Форма на -g- (tengo) буває лише в теперішньому часі. В імперфекті: tenía."
cases.defect: The explanation overgeneralizes: the teng- stem also occurs in formal imperatives such as tenga and tengan. Its absence from the imperfect does not mean it occurs only in present-tense forms.
cases.correction: Limit the explanation to the contrast being taught: the present stem teng- does not carry into the imperfect; tener → tenía.
sources: RAE/ASALE, Diccionario de la lengua española, tener conjugation table: present subjunctive and imperative forms tenga, tengan (from memory).
